## Tasks

- [ ] **T-001 — Freeze persistence and assurance contracts.** Objective: define `context-capsule/v1`, immutable `projection-bundle/v1`, `projection-transaction-receipt/v1`, `assurance-policy/v1`, stable blocked states, and migration rules. Context: persistence is mandatory while assurance remains proportional; Deep cannot be weakened, and later evidence cannot circularly redefine prepared authority. Affected modules: `references/context-capsule-v1.md`, `references/projection-bundle-v1.md`, `references/phase-contracts.md`, `references/run-manifest.md`, `README.md`, `tests/test_assurance_contracts.py`. Requirements: specify invariant fields, lifecycle, prepared-versus-final binding, slot states, the low-risk progress corridor, six closed hard boundaries, legacy mappings, privacy, external-action boundaries, and examples. Verification: schema fixtures and documentation contract tests map AC-001 through AC-005, AC-008, AC-012, and AC-013. Complete when: contracts are versioned, internally consistent, and executable by later tasks. Owner lane: workflow-contracts. `depends_on: []`.

- [ ] **T-002 — Implement projection workflow.** Objective: implement projection workflow to freeze source bytes once and derive an immutable prepared bundle plus a separately bound transaction receipt. Context: this fixes the projection-disagreement root cause without relaxing validators or creating circular hashes as evidence arrives. Affected modules: `scripts/projection_bundle.py`, `scripts/projection_kernel.py`, `scripts/plan_protocol_core.py`, `scripts/plan_phase_validation.py`, `tests/test_projection_kernel.py`. Requirements: content addressing, canonical serialization, version registry, explicit slot states, prepared/final envelope binding, atomic local writes, conflict diagnostics, and durable blocked receipts. Verification: unit and mutation fixtures prove byte identity, deterministic IDs, version sensitivity, prepared-identity stability, explicit omission, no partial success, and AC-006/AC-007. Complete when: every adapter receives the same frozen buffer and conflicts identify the responsible version/projection without mutating prepared authority. Owner lane: projection-core. `depends_on: [T-001]`.

- [ ] **T-003 — Implement persistence workflow.** Objective: implement persistence workflow for compact semantic context across sessions in every tier. Context: context persistence is the invariant product, independent of Heavy assurance validity. Affected modules: `scripts/context_capsule.py`, `scripts/init_run.py`, `scripts/progress_control.py`, `scripts/run_status.py`, `tests/test_context_capsule.py`. Requirements: create/checkpoint/resume/fork/compact/supersede/archive, digest chains, compare-and-swap, source-drift checks, bounded evidence references, privacy minimization, and truthful achieved assurance. Verification: independent-process resume, corruption, compaction, concurrent-writer, source-drift, privacy, and blocked-Heavy tests satisfy AC-002 and AC-008. Complete when: a Light, Heavy, interrupted, and invalid run can resume from verified capsule state. Owner lane: persistence. `depends_on: [T-001, T-002]`.

- [ ] **T-004 — Configure assurance policy.** Objective: configure assurance policy for Light/Cheap and Heavy/Expensive bundle slots and gates. Context: rigor must be opt-in except at six named hard boundaries. Affected modules: `scripts/intent_router.py`, `scripts/validate_tier.py`, `scripts/progress_control.py`, `scripts/risk_floor.py`, `SKILL.md`, `tests/test_assurance_routing.py`. Requirements: two-axis mode/assurance grammar with one leading selector, status-selector rejection, Heavy-compatible phase and inferred defaults, preflight gate/cost summary, no silent escalation, exact Deep-to-Heavy mapping, compatibility inputs for Quick/Balanced, explicit omissions, invalid-combination blockers, a tested low-risk action allowlist, and authorize/narrow/stop outcomes. Verification: exhaustive grammar and risk matrices cover the authoritative plan command, every explicit phase, freeform inference, status, selector ordering and multiplicity, unsupported combinations, legacy tier requested/effective/subprofile/origin fields, the complete low-risk progress corridor, all six hard boundaries, unknown classifications, declined escalation resume, and Heavy parity for AC-001/AC-003/AC-004/AC-005. Complete when: selection and escalation are deterministic, inspectable, and backward compatible. Owner lane: assurance-policy. `depends_on: [T-001, T-003]`.

- [ ] **T-005 — Adapt validation workflow.** Objective: adapt validation workflow to task parsing, graph policy/draft, visual disposition, audit inputs, and remote read-back through the shared kernel transaction. Context: strict validators remain independently meaningful but cannot reread mutable authority. Affected modules: `scripts/plan_tasks.py`, `scripts/plan_graph.py`, `scripts/visual_applicability.py`, `scripts/visual_policy.py`, `scripts/plan_audits.py`, `scripts/preflight_plan.py`, `scripts/graph_transaction.py`, `tests/test_projection_convergence.py`, `tests/fixtures/projection_convergence/`. Requirements: adapter version binding, closed typed vocabularies, shared input digest, staged external intent, normalized read-back binding, and per-projection diagnostics. Verification: golden convergence fixtures plus newline, unknown-vocabulary, encrypted-auditor-proof, changed-projection, crash-before-read-back, and remote-mismatch mutations satisfy AC-006/AC-007. Complete when: independent projections cannot claim validity against different authority bytes. Owner lane: plan-conformance. `depends_on: [T-002]`.

- [ ] **T-006 — Implement provider validation.** Objective: implement provider validation for Plan #10's `delegation-proof/v1` interface and Sol Advisor generic capability evidence. Context: provider identity is fixture data, not core policy, and artifact chains remain separate. Affected modules: `scripts/provider_receipts.py`, `scripts/delegation_router.py`, `references/role-contracts.md`, `tests/test_provider_receipts.py`, `tests/fixtures/provider_qualification/`. Requirements: hard entry-gate read-back of issue 10 VALID Plan, completed Implement and Review receipts, merged commit and exact interface version; then requested/observed role, model class, effort, isolation, permissions, canonical path, freshness, contradictions, user-visible opt-in, and no fallback. Verification: upstream receipt and merged-SHA compatibility, provider substitution, exact pin, canonical path/cutoff, null isolation, stale/missing/contradictory evidence, opt-in lane, and no-fallback tests satisfy AC-010/AC-011. Complete when: the upstream receipt, merged SHA, and interface version are bound and Sol Advisor plus a second fixture pass or block solely through the same provider-neutral contract. Owner lane: runtime-evidence. `depends_on: [T-001, T-002]`.

- [ ] **T-007 — Instrument workflow gates.** Objective: instrument workflow gates for measurable cost and distinct assurance contribution in local artifacts. Context: rigor without a distinct failure class or outcome signal risks micromanagement. Affected modules: `scripts/workflow_gate_validation.py`, `scripts/record_retrospective.py`, `references/continuous-improvement.md`, `references/run-manifest.md`, `tests/test_workflow_gate_validation.py`. Requirements: registry fields for applicability, failure class, expected/actual duration, cost proxy, finding, remediation, raw denominators, duplicate-finding rate, and downstream outcome or `INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE`; duplicate-control diagnostics; human-reviewed retirement only; no telemetry. Verification: fixtures reject malformed or undeclared registry records, preserve insufficient evidence, report overlapping failure classes and duplicate findings as non-authoritative diagnostics, preserve every active required gate, record no-finding and escaped outcomes, prohibit automatic retirement, and prove no network write for AC-009. Complete when: every optional Heavy gate has an evidence-bearing economics record. Owner lane: workflow-economics. `depends_on: [T-001, T-004]`.

- [ ] **T-008 — Implement migration workflow.** Objective: implement migration workflow for shadow comparison with legacy Deep behavior and read-only installation drift. Context: local baseline and remote main can differ, and historical receipts cannot be rewritten. Affected modules: `scripts/migrate_plan_protocol.py`, `scripts/verify_skill_sync.py`, `scripts/init_run.py`, `tests/test_migrate_plan_protocol.py`, `tests/fixtures/projection_migration/`, `tests/fixtures/distribution_drift/`. Requirements: shadow bundles, legacy envelopes, original hash retention, mismatch blockers, current/prior readers, independent feature controls, read-only `IN_SYNC`/`DRIFT`/`UNKNOWN`, and rollback. Verification: historical fixtures, fresh clone, current-vs-installed drift, missing-module, unsupported-version, rollback, and no-install-write tests satisfy AC-012/AC-013. Complete when: cutover is blocked on any unexplained divergence and rollback preserves capsules and receipts. Owner lane: migration-distribution. `depends_on: [T-003, T-004, T-005, T-006, T-007]`.
